what: Plan lowers the documented runtime floor to 3.11 but omits the live /report-tokens runtime selector, which still rejects Python 3.11.
scenario_or_breakage: A user with python3 == 3.11 follows the updated docs, runs /report-tokens, and the wrapper exits with “requires Python 3.12 or newer” before the stdlib Python entrypoint can run.
suggested_fix: Add skills/report-tokens/scripts/run-analysis.sh to the proposed file list and change only this guard/message from >= 3.12 to >= 3.11.

what: Plan says lowering python/pyproject.toml is enough and that Ruff infers the target, but current lint configs explicitly pin the analysis floor to 3.12.
scenario_or_breakage: The proposed 3.11/3.12 CI matrix can go green while py-lint still analyzes as 3.12, so 3.12-only APIs or syntax are not reliably flagged as incompatible with the new floor.
suggested_fix: Add these three config files to the version-floor change and lower or remove the explicit 3.12 analysis pins so py-lint validates Python 3.11 compatibility.
